HOIOTO 12V 5A 60W AC Switching Adapter – Reliable Power for Hikvision/Dahua NVR & DVR Systems

The HOIOTO 12V 5A 60W AC Switching Adapter is a high-quality power supply designed to provide stable and efficient power to Hikvision and Dahua video recorders, including NVRs and DVRs. Built with safety and durability in mind, this adapter ensures smooth operation of your surveillance systems around the clock.

Perfect for security setups in homes, offices, and commercial environments, the HOIOTO adapter supports a wide input voltage range and delivers consistent 12V DC output, protecting your devices from voltage fluctuations, overheating, and overcurrent issues.

Technical Specifications:

  • Input Voltage: 100–240V AC, 50/60Hz
  • Output Voltage: 12V DC
  • Output Current: 5A
  • Power Output: 60W
  • Connector Type: Standard DC plug (compatible with most NVR/DVR systems)
  • Cable Length: Approx. 1 meter (may vary by model)
  • Protection: Over-voltage, over-current, short circuit, and thermal protection

Key Features:

  • Compatible with Hikvision and Dahua NVR/DVR video recorders
  • Stable 12V output for uninterrupted surveillance system operation
  • Compact and lightweight design for easy installation
  • Built-in safety protections to prevent equipment damage
  • Ideal for CCTV systems, routers, and other 12V devices
  • Energy-efficient, durable, and long-lasting performance
